{"notes": "VISIT 1 (left at 1:00). Plan: fish, Hana's sketch, accepted by all. Strokes seem split as Hana = top body, Omar = stroke 3 upper tail, Jack = stroke 4 lower tail, Sofia presumably stroke 2 / bottom body (my assumption, unconfirmed).

Table state: two dark chains run from START. The upper arc reaches about (10, 5.3). One pale, disconnected domino sits just past its end at about (10.5, 5.5), so there is a small gap or joint problem there. The lower arc is longer and smooth, reaching about (15, 14.4), and is all connected. I don't know who placed which dominoes, so I'm not crediting or blaming anyone for the picture yet.

Hana: Proposed the fish sketch and got buy-in. Gave clear coordination ('everyone's on their piece', 'shout if a joint breaks'). Said she's on the top body. Early leadership looks good, but I haven't seen her execution.

Omar: Quickly agreed ('love it'), claimed upper tail stroke 3 and said he was tracing it. The upper arc has the pale gap at its end, so check whether that's his stroke. No evidence of fault yet.

Jack: Supportive, claimed lower tail stroke 4 and was working on it. The lower arc looks clean and long, but I can't confirm it's his.

Sofia: Said nothing while I was there and I saw nothing from her. No assessment possible. Ask her privately or watch on the next visit. Silence isn't evidence of low contribution.

Next visit: check the upper gap, see whether the two body strokes join up, and watch who spots and fixes problems."}
